newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex reaches first connection accord.
newsitem.headline: Telmex reaches first connection accord.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Telefonos de Mexico SA (Telmex) said Thursday it had reached a first interconnection accord with Avantel SA, a new long distance operator which will begin services January 1, 1997.

Telmex gave no details of the agreement, only saying that the accord was reached through its subsidiary Telefonos del Norte, known as Telnor, and that the pact will allow Avantel to use Telmex's and Telnor's networks to offer long distance services.
Telmex's telephone monopoly ends on the first day of 1997 and a host of domestic and inetrnational companies have lined up to compete in long distance markets.
